Back to PlussTils

PlussTils’ reference material is organized by domain:

  • PlussView architecture: how the desktop viewer is put together.

  • PlussView window runtime: the runtime behavior of a live viewer window.

  • MATLAB-style popup viewer roadmap: planned work for a popup-viewer surface.

Pathing and Aux (including pluss::OutputEngine) are not documented here yet.
